Os animais foram alimentados com ração comercial extrusada para carnívoros ($6{,}0\text{ mm}$ de diâmetro), contendo 42% de proteína bruta, 11% de lipídeos, 20% de carboidratos e $4.380\text{ kcal}\cdot\text{kg}^{-1}$ de energia bruta. Não foram observadas diferenças estatisticamente significativas ($p > 0{,}05$) para os parâmetros de crescimento, teor corporal de proteínas e lipídeos, nem para as atividades de lipases e proteases alcalinas entre os tratamentos. Em contrapartida, a atividade da amilase variou significativamente ($p < 0{,}05$). Os resultados indicam que o cultivo de juvenis de suruvi pode ser manejado de forma sustentável com apenas uma refeição diária.

Este trabalho apresenta dois objetivos centrais: i) analisar o fluxo de transações ao longo da cadeia agroindustrial do algodão, mapeando as etapas desde a aquisição de insumos, produção agrícola e beneficiamento até o processamento industrial da fibra e do caroço; e ii) mensurar, por meio de modelos de séries temporais aplicadas, a direção e a intensidade da transmissão de choques dos preços da fibra de algodão para os preços do vestuário ao consumidor final. O algodão em caroço passa pelo beneficiamento, originando caroço, fibrilha e pluma (fibra). O caroço destina-se ao esmagamento, extração de óleo, deslintamento ou fabricação de ração animal, enquanto a fibrilha atende a usos industriais diversos. A pluma concentra o maior valor agregado, alimentando a indústria têxtil na etapa de fiação, de onde segue, isolada ou mesclada a fibras sintéticas, para tecelagem, malharia, confecção e acabamento, gerando artigos de vestuário, cama, mesa, banho e produtos técnicos comercializados no atacado e varejo. Investigou-se em que medida os ganhos de eficiência na cotonicultura foram repassados ao consumidor final brasileiro, avaliando a transmissão de preços da pluma para os segmentos de fios, tecidos e vestuário no varejo entre janeiro de 2000 e dezembro de 2018. Os resultados revelaram forte integração entre o preço da pluma e o preço dos fios, contudo a transmissão de preços mostrou-se inexpressiva nos elos jusantes da cadeia. Conclui-se que a fraca sensibilidade dos preços do vestuário às variações da pluma decorre do elevado volume e valor das importações de fibras sintéticas e manufaturados têxteis.

No dimensionamento de estruturas de madeira segundo os critérios de segurança regulamentares, a resistência característica a um determinado esforço mecânico corresponde ao percentil de 5% de um modelo de distribuição de probabilidades ajustado. A norma brasileira ABNT NBR 7190 estabelece equações simplificadas para a estimativa da resistência característica em amostras pequenas, as quais podem divergir dos valores obtidos por modelos probabilísticos rigorosos. A partir de dados experimentais da resistência à tração paralela às fibras ($f_{t0,k}$) de 40 espécies de folhosas (480 corpos de prova com teor de umidade padronizado a ~12%), avaliaram-se as funções de densidade de probabilidade Normal, Log-Normal, Weibull e Exponencial para identificar o modelo de maior aderência por espécie. Com os valores característicos e os respetivos modelos determinados, ajustou-se um modelo de regressão linear multivariada com base em análise de variância (ANOVA), considerando como variáveis independentes a média ($\bar{x}$), o coeficiente de variação ($\text{CV}\%$) e os valores mínimo ($\text{min}$) e máximo ($\text{max}$) de cada espécie. A inserção dos termos estatisticamente significativos visou aprimorar a qualidade do estimador da resistência característica ajustada ($f_{t0,k,\text{ajustado}}$) e a confiabilidade na determinação dessa propriedade mecânica. Por fim, o modelo de regressão proposto foi comparado às equações da norma ABNT NBR 7190 para aferir sua precisão e adequação na estimativa do parâmetro $f_{t0,k}$.

O crescimento urbano desordenado e o adensamento das atividades antrópicas alteram o microclima das cidades, impactando a qualidade de vida da população. Esta pesquisa analisou a variação espacial e temporal da temperatura da superfície terrestre (TST) por meio de sensoriamento remoto, visando identificar e caracterizar ilhas de calor e de frescor no município de São Paulo (densidade demográfica de $7.398{,}26\text{ hab/km}^2$ e população superior a 12 milhões de habitantes). Utilizaram-se imagens do satélite Landsat 5 processadas pelo algoritmo SEBAL (*Surface Energy Balance Algorithm for Land*). Os resultados demonstraram uma tendência de elevação na TST ao longo dos anos examinados. O surgimento de ilhas de calor no município correlacionou-se à concentração de distritos industriais, à expansão da mancha urbana e ao elevado grau de impermeabilização do solo por pavimentação asfáltica. Por outro lado, mapearam-se zonas de frescor associadas prioritariamente a maciços vegetados e áreas verdes urbanas, as quais desempenham papel relevante no amortecimento térmico e no bem-estar populacional.

O gênero *Evolvulus* L. (Convolvulaceae) engloba aproximadamente 100 espécies com distribuição predominantemente neotropical, além de duas espécies pantropicais (*E. nummularius* e *E. alsinoides*). No Brasil, são registradas 73 espécies, tendo o Cerrado e a Caatinga como principais centros de diversidade. Este trabalho apresentou o tratamento taxonômico do gênero *Evolvulus* no estado de Pernambuco. Realizaram-se 17 expedições de campo e o exame de 512 espécimes provenientes de 26 herbários. Identificaram-se 17 espécies em Pernambuco; a maioria possui ampla distribuição nacional, à exceção de *E. daphnoides* e *E. saxatilis*, restritas ao domínio da Caatinga. *Evolvulus filipes* e *E. glomeratus* destacam-se pela ocorrência em todas as zonas fitogeográficas do estado. *Evolvulus elaeagnifolius*, *E. sericeus* e *E. tenuis* apresentaram distribuição disjunta entre a Zona da Mata (Floresta Atlântica) e o Sertão (Caatinga). A maior riqueza de espécies concentrou-se na vegetação de Caatinga hiperxerófila sobre solos de areias quartzosas no Sertão, com exceção de *E. nummularius*, restrita à Zona da Mata em solos podzólicos. *Evolvulus glomeratus* ocorreu também em afloramentos rochosos, enquanto *E. saxatilis* e *E. saxifragus* mostraram-se de ocorrência exclusiva nesse tipo de substrato na área de estudo. Fornecem-se chave de identificação, descrições morfológicas, dados de distribuição geográfica, comentários taxonômicos e ecológicos, além de ilustrações das espécies.

*Mangifera indica* L. (mangueira) é uma espécie exótica invasora na Região Nordeste do Brasil, cuja presença no estado do Ceará exige especial atenção na Área de Proteção Ambiental (APA) da Serra de Baturité (setor norte do estado). A sinergia entre a bioinvasão e o aquecimento global, somada ao escasso conhecimento sobre a distribuição geográfica local da espécie, limita as estratégias de controle e manejo futuro. Os objetivos deste estudo foram: i) modelar a distribuição geográfica potencial de áreas climaticamente adequadas para *M. indica* no bioma Caatinga em cenários climáticos futuros; e ii) avaliar a dinâmica espaço-temporal dessas projeções, com foco na APA da Serra de Baturité. A modelagem utilizou o algoritmo MaxEnt, considerando os horizontes temporais de 1961–1990 (clima atual de referência), 2041–2060 (2050) e 2061–2080 (2070), sob os cenários RCP 4.5 e 8.5 do CMIP5. Foram gerados cinco modelos, dos quais as projeções para 2070 indicaram uma contração superior a 50% nas áreas de elevado potencial de ocorrência da espécie.

A produção mundial de noz-pecã (*Carya illinoinensis*, Juglandaceae) é liderada pelos Estados Unidos. No Brasil, e em particular no Rio Grande do Sul, observou-se expressiva expansão da área cultivada nos últimos anos. Contudo, escasseiam pesquisas sobre a entomofauna associada e práticas culturais aplicadas ao Manejo Integrado de Pragas (MIP). O objetivo deste trabalho foi avaliar a comunidade de artrópodes na copa de plantas de *C. illinoinensis* submetidas a diferentes manejos de solo em Santa Maria, Rio Grande do Sul. Adotou-se o delineamento experimental em blocos ao acaso, com cinco blocos e quatro tratamentos de preparo de solo e plantio: cova pequena de 20 cm × 60 cm (Sp); subsolador acompanhado de grade niveladora e cova pequena (Ssp); enxada rotativa e cova pequena (Tsp); e cova grande de 40 cm × 60 cm (Lp). De novembro de 2014 a maio de 2015, amostraram-se 7.617 espécimes nas copas de árvores jovens. Identificaram-se 150 grupos taxonômicos, destacando-se Coleoptera como a ordem de maior riqueza específica. *Monellia caryella* (Hemiptera: Aphididae) apresentou elevada densidade populacional. Dentre os inimigos naturais registrados, destacam-se Hymenoptera parasitoides e Coccinellidae. Conclui-se que a diversidade da artropodofauna nas copas de nogueiras-pecã jovens é similar entre os manejos de solo testados, observando-se predomínio de *M. caryella* nas áreas avaliadas.

Este artigo analisa o impacto do arcabouço cultural do tradutor na tradução de metáforas de paisagem mediante análise contrastiva entre a obra *La madre*, da romancista Grazia Deledda (Prêmio Nobel de Literatura), e sua tradução para o inglês, *The Mother* (1922), realizada por Mary Steegman. A cultura molda a percepção da natureza ao estabelecer normas e ideologias que orientam a relação humana com o meio ambiente. Em Deledda, a linguagem espacial deriva de uma apreensão subjetiva, refletindo-se no emprego de metáforas espaciais. Na tradução, todavia, a negociação de sentidos que envolve as metáforas da paisagem torna-se mais complexa: a subjetividade do autor sobrepõe-se à do tradutor, gerando desdobramentos políticos e ideológicos no texto de chegada. O estudo investiga especificamente o antropomorfismo e a relação entre metáfora e símile, argumentando que a interpretação da tradutora reconfigura a apreensão da paisagem pelo leitor-alvo. A fundamentação teórica apoia-se na Teoria da Metáfora Conceitual, na Hipótese da Tradução Cognitiva de Mandelblit (1995) e na Ecoestilística, fornecendo subsídios para examinar os padrões que revelam a atitude da tradutora em relação à natureza.

Este artigo apresenta uma nova topologia de conversor CC–CC bidirecional Push-Pull / Flyback. Realiza-se um estudo detalhado em ambos os sentidos de operação, contemplando análise teórica, equacionamento matemático e determinação do ganho estático nos modos de condução contínua (MCC), descontínua (MCD) e crítica (MCCr), além de validação experimental. O conversor proposto é adequado para barramentos de corrente contínua em microrredes que integram acumuladores de energia e fontes CC (células a combustível, geradores fotovoltaicos e turbinas eólicas). A topologia permite fluxo bidirecional de potência e elevado ganho de tensão, viabilizando a interface com baterias e ultracapacitores, os quais operam em baixa tensão de saída e demandam correntes elevadas com baixa ondulação (*ripple*). A exequibilidade do conversor com isolamento galvânico foi confirmada por um protótipo experimental, obtendo-se eficiência superior a 90,1% com potência nominal de 4 kW no sentido direto, e rendimento de 84,3% com potência de 1,3 kW no sentido inverso.

A despeito do debate contínuo sobre a formação acadêmica em Turismo e de sua presença em eventos científicos, persistem lacunas de informação relativas à empregabilidade dos egressos. Observa-se um histórico distanciamento entre os objetivos das instituições formadoras — focadas na construção acadêmica e humanística — e as demandas do mercado de trabalho, que busca profissionais com competências operacionais consolidando-se ao longo da graduação. A partir da comparação de dados do perfil profissional dos graduados nos anos de 2012 e 2018, este artigo discute o mercado de trabalho dos egressos de cursos superiores de Turismo no Brasil, contemplando atividades principais, setores de inserção e níveis remuneratórios. Trata-se de estudo descritivo de natureza qualitativa na interpretação dos dados primários e secundários. Os resultados indicam que a inserção profissional é menos diversificada do que o postulado pelas matrizes curriculares, evidenciando a concentração dos turismólogos em poucas áreas de atuação. Observou-se, ainda, modesta elevação salarial, ampliação da atuação no magistério superior e aumento de egressos vinculados ao setor público.

A despatologização das identidades transexuais e travestis resulta de um processo histórico impulsionado por movimentos sociais e categorias profissionais. Entre os avanços institucionais recentes, destaca-se a remoção da transexualidade da seção de transtornos mentais na 11ª Revisão da Classificação Internacional de Doenças (CID-11), passando a figurar como condição relativa à saúde sexual. Paralelamente, a Psicologia tem consolidado posicionamentos em defesa da diversidade de gênero e da livre orientação sexual. Este artigo, estruturado sob a forma de ensaio científico de perspectiva feminista, discute essa conjuntura sob a ótica de uma psicóloga coordenadora do Grupo de Trabalho sobre a População LGBT no Conselho Regional de Psicologia da 3ª Região (CRP 03/BA) e alinhada aos debates do Sistema Conselhos de Psicologia sobre Direitos Humanos. As diretrizes do Conselho Federal de Psicologia e dos Conselhos Regionais têm-se intensificado no sentido de rever paradigmas e combater as desigualdades decorrentes da patologização da população trans. Por se tratar de um campo de atuação em consolidação, o trabalho visa visibilizar as práticas contemporâneas e contribuir para o avanço teórico-prático da temática na Psicologia.

A aplicação e o valor comercial dos produtos de madeira sólida dependem diretamente do seu padrão de qualidade superficial, aspecto crítico na indústria moveleira. A caracterização do comportamento da madeira ao processo de usinagem constitui parâmetro essencial para indicar suas aplicações tecnológicas. Este estudo objetivou avaliar a qualidade da superfície usinada da madeira de clones de *Toona ciliata* M. Roemer var. *australis*, determinar seus potenciais de uso e identificar o clone com melhor desempenho. Selecionaram-se 35 árvores (7 clones × 5 repetições) provenientes de um plantio no sul de Minas Gerais. De cada indivíduo, retirou-se um tora de 1,0 m de comprimento (extraído na seção de 0,3 a 1,3 m a partir da base), que foi desdobrada em tábuas. A secagem ocorreu ao ar livre e à sombra até atingir o teor de umidade de equilíbrio. O aplainamento e desengrosso foram executados nas velocidades de avanço de 6 m·min⁻¹ e 30 m·min⁻¹. A avaliação da qualidade da superfície envolveu análise visual, segundo os critérios da norma ASTM D-1666 (2011), e ensaio de rugosidade superficial. O clone 1 apresentou a superior qualidade de superfície usinada, e constatou-se que a elevação da velocidade de avanço reduziu o padrão de acabamento superficial das peças.

Este artigo examina os documentos relativos à beata Germana Maria da Purificação (1782–1853), que apresentava êstases religiosos na Capela de Nossa Senhora da Piedade da Serra, em Caeté, MG. O parecer formulado pelos cirurgiões Antônio Pedro de Sousa e Manuel Quintão da Silva atribuía as manifestações a fenômenos de ordem sobrenatural. Essa interpretação foi contestada pelo médico mineiro Antônio Gonçalves Gomide (1770–1835), diplomado na Europa, na obra *Impugnação Analítica (...)*, publicada pela Imprensa Régia em 1814. Esse acervo documental permite analisar o campo médico no Brasil do início do século XIX, evidenciando as disputas entre a medicina acadêmica e a prática cirúrgica. Fundamentando-se na ciência ilustrada e nas teorias da medicina douta, Gomide recorreu aos trabalhos de Philippe Pinel (1745–1826) e outros alienistas para interpretar os sintomas da beata como afecção nervosa, produzindo um dos primeiros registros sobre o alienismo no país. O estudo propõe uma releitura da historiografia das doenças mentais no Brasil, demonstrando que o conhecimento científico sobre a alienação já circulava no território nacional na década de 1810.

A explotação de ouro em cascalhos auríferos em calhas fluviais na Amazônia é realizada de forma assistemática por meio de dragas de sucção e escarificação, promovendo a remobilização e o incremento de sedimentos em suspensão, o que acentua processos de assoreamento e erosão marginal. Este trabalho avaliou a eficácia da sísmica de reflexão de alta resolução na identificação de armadilhas geológicas associadas a cascalhos auríferos na calha do rio Peixoto de Azevedo. A aquisição de dados ocorreu durante o período de cheia ao longo de um trecho de 2.700 m, utilizando-se um perfilador de subfundo com emissão de frequência entre 2 e 15 kHz. Os resultados permitiram mapear três fácies sísmicas e duas superfícies de reflexão. As fácies correspondem aos depósitos arenosos atuais da calha (Sf1), aos paleossedimentos argilosos e conglomeráticos/cascalhos (Sf2) e às rochas ígneas do embasamento (Sf3). As superfícies de reflexão representam as interfaces entre os sedimentos atuais e os paleossedimentos (Ss), e entre estes e o embasamento ígneo (Sr). As deflexões observadas na superfície Sr indicam a presença de depressões estruturais com potencial para o acúmulo de cascalhos auríferos.

A intervenção penal no âmbito da União Europeia tem sido caracterizada por um processo de expansão, intensificação e proliferação de instrumentos normativos, sobretudo a partir do Tratado de Lisboa, fortalecendo a cooperação judiciária, o reconhecimento mútuo e a harmonização legislativa. Com a aprovação do Regulamento (UE) 2017/1939 do Conselho, de 12 de outubro de 2017, que instituiu a Procuradoria Europeia via cooperação reforçada, o bloco aproxima-se do exercício transnacional da ação penal. A partir da análise dessa evolução e das metamorfoses da intervenção penal europeia pós-Lisboa, este artigo analisa o sentido e o alcance do Regulamento da Procuradoria Europeia, examinando o modelo de justiça penal emergente. Discute-se se a criação do órgão sinaliza uma integração penal plena ou se representa uma etapa intermediária no processo, avaliando suas contribuições para o sistema de justiça penal e a viabilidade de ampliação de sua competência para abranger crimes graves de dimensão transfronteiriça.

O objetivo deste trabalho foi aprimorar a previsão da velocidade do vento por meio do modelo atmosférico de mesoescala *Weather Research and Forecasting* (WRF) associado a Redes Neurais Artificiais (RNA) do tipo Não Linear Autorregressiva com Entrada Externa (NARX) e sem entrada externa (NAR). A acurácia dos prognósticos foi avaliada em comparação com dados observados (OBS) registrados a cada 10 minutos em uma torre anemométrica de 50 m de altura, localizada em Craíbas, na região Agreste de Alagoas. A análise estatística univariada indicou que os prognósticos representaram satisfatoriamente a evolução temporal do vento no período analisado (abril de 2015). As velocidades média, máxima e mínima observadas foram de 5,26 m·s⁻¹, 12,29 m·s⁻¹ e 0,01 m·s⁻¹, respectivamente, enquanto os valores previstos variaram nas faixas de 5,18 a 5,41 m·s⁻¹ (média), 11,58 a 13,92 m·s⁻¹ (máxima) e 0,01 a 0,36 m·s⁻¹ (mínima). Na análise bivariada, as métricas de desempenho resultaram em: desvio médio entre -0,31 e 0,04 m·s⁻¹; raiz do erro quadrático médio de 1,14 a 1,27 m·s⁻¹; erro percentual absoluto médio de 22 a 23%; e coeficiente de correlação entre 0,63 e 0,72. Apesar do horizonte temporal restrito da série de dados, os resultados evidenciam o potencial da integração entre RNA e o modelo WRF para a previsão do recurso eólico.

O gênero *Lytoneuron* Klotzsch pertence à família Pteridaceae (subfamília Cheilanthoideae) e foi segregado de *Doryopteris* s.l. com base em evidências moleculares e morfológicas que sustentam seu monofiletismo. Este estudo fundamentou-se na análise de espécimes coletados em expedições de campo e em acervos de herbários para inventariar o gênero no estado do Rio de Janeiro. Registraram-se 11 espécies de *Lytoneuron* no estado, das quais nove são endêmicas do Brasil e restritas ao bioma Mata Atlântica (*Lytoneuron acutilobum*, *L. feei*, *L. itatiaiense*, *L. ornithopus*, *L. paradoxum*, *L. quinquelobatum*, *L. rosenstockii*, *L. subsimplex* e *L. tijucanum*). As espécies *L. quinquelobatum*, *L. subsimplex* e *L. tijucanum* apresentam distribuição geográfica conhecida exclusivamente no território fluminense. Apresentam-se descrições morfológicas, comentários taxonômicos, ilustrações e uma chave analítica de identificação para as espécies registradas.

Este artigo analisou a abordagem do conceito de célula nos livros didáticos de Biologia aprovados pelo Programa Nacional do Livro Didático (PNLD 2015), investigando seus aspectos conceituais e socio-históricos para estabelecer articulações entre as concepções de ciência e de mundo veiculadas nessas obras. Adotaram-se como aporte teórico-metodológico o materialismo histórico-dialético e os Estatutos Estruturantes da Biologia. Os resultados revelam que a maioria dos manuais omite o processo histórico de construção do conceito de célula, transmitindo uma visão de ciência aproblemática, a-histórica, dogmática e cristalizada. Conclui-se que a organização estrutural do conteúdo celular nas obras analisadas obstaculiza a compreensão do conhecimento biológico como construção socio-histórica.

Os alimentos extrusados do tipo *snacks* apresentam ampla aceitação comercial em razão da variedade de formas, texturas e sabores, além da praticidade de consumo. Contudo, a maioria das formulações comerciais exibe reduzido valor nutricional e elevado teor de cloreto de sódio (NaCl). No Brasil, a Resolução da Diretoria Colegiada (RDC) n.º 26, de 2 de julho de 2015, regulamentou a obrigatoriedade da declaração de ingredientes alergênicos na rotulagem de alimentos embalados, persistindo a escassez de estudos de conformidade em produtos processados. Este trabalho objetivou: i) avaliar a conformidade dos rótulos de *snacks* comerciais frente às exigências da RDC n.º 26/2015; e ii) quantificar o teor de sódio por espectrometria de absorção atômica com chama (FAAS), comparando-o aos valores declarados na tabela de informação nutricional. A avaliação da rotulagem de 16 marcas comerciais identificou inconformidades em quatro delas (25%), destacando-se a omissão da declaração obrigatória de ingredientes alergênicos, como a farinha de trigo. Constatou-se que 87,5% dos produtos continham algum ingrediente alergênico e apenas 68,75% atendiam plenamente à RDC n.º 26/2015. Ademais, a maioria dos rótulos omitia informações sobre o risco de contaminação cruzada durante o processamento. A quantificação analítica revelou que a concentração de sódio na maioria das amostras era elevada e divergente dos teores informados nos rótulos. Conclui-se que o teor excessivo de sódio nos *snacks* analisados pode favorecer a superação da ingestão diária recomendada, potencializando riscos associados a doenças cardiovasculares e crônicas não transmissíveis.

As afecções do sistema respiratório constituem a segunda causa de queda de desempenho e de afastamento de equinos de atividades esportivas ou de trabalho, superadas apenas pelas afecções musculoesqueléticas. O manejo em sistema de estabulação e a alimentação baseada no fornecimento de feno predispõem os animais à inalação contínua de agentes irritantes nas vias aéreas. Com o objetivo de avaliar a influência de diferentes substratos de cama sobre o sistema respiratório, acompanharam-se 15 equinos distribuídos em três grupos experimentais por 45 dias: dois grupos mantidos em cocheiras com cama à base de madeira — maravalha de pinus autoclavada (MA) e serragem (SE) — e um grupo mantido em sistema de pastejo extensivo (controle). Realizaram-se avaliações quinzenais compreendendo exame físico, hemograma, hemogasometria e lavado broncoalveolar (LBA). Ao exame clínico, observou-se a ocorrência de tosse e espirros exclusivamente nos animais do grupo SE. A contagem de células nucleadas totais no LBA apresentou maiores valores nos animais mantidos a pasto, seguidos pelo grupo SE e, por fim, pelo grupo MA. Conclui-se que os dois tipos de cama avaliados não apresentaram diferenças estatisticamente significativas quanto ao potencial irritativo sobre as vias aéreas superiores no período experimental analisado.

O sucesso na conservação de sementes fundamenta-se na desaceleração do metabolismo embrionário e do desenvolvimento de organismos associados. A intensidade metabólica pode ser aferida pelas taxas respiratórias, demandando a padronização de protocolos metodológicos específicos. A utilização de atmosferas modificadas tem demonstrado eficácia no controle da atividade respiratória mediante a manipulação das concentrações de $\text{O}_2$ e $\text{CO}_2$. Este trabalho avaliou a influência de alterações nas concentrações gasosas ambientais sobre a inibição do metabolismo respiratório em sementes de *Eugenia brasiliensis* Lam. (Myrtaceae). Os resultados demonstraram que atmosferas contendo entre 1,9% e 3,7% de $\text{CO}_2$ promovem a redução efetiva da taxa respiratória das sementes. Adicionalmente, propõe-se um modelo metodológico para o controle de variáveis analíticas na mensuração das taxas respiratórias em sementes da espécie.

Diante da crescente escassez de água doce e da elevação da demanda hídrica global e nacional, a dessalinização consolida-se como alternativa para a potabilização de águas salobras e salgadas. Este estudo avaliou a eficiência de um sistema piloto de dessalinização de água salobra, constituído por uma mistura de água de mar e de rio ajustada para a concentração de sólidos dissolvidos totais (SDT) de $1.500\text{ mg}\cdot\text{L}^{-1}$. O sistema piloto, com capacidade operacional de $1{,}0\text{ m}^3\cdot\text{h}^{-1}$, é composto por unidades de ultrafiltração (UF) e abrandamento como pré-tratamento para o módulo de osmose reversa (OR). Analisaram-se amostras na entrada e na saída dos módulos de tratamento quanto a SDT, condutividade elétrica, turbidez, pH, cor aparente, alcalinidade, dureza total, cálcio, magnésio, cloreto, sulfato e temperatura. Avaliaram-se também a pressão osmótica, o fluxo de filtração e a taxa de recuperação no módulo de OR. O sistema atingiu uma eficiência de remoção de 99% para SDT e condutividade elétrica. A ultrafiltração mostrou-se eficaz na remoção da turbidez, enquanto a osmose reversa apresentou elevada capacidade de retenção de íons salinos, garantindo a adequação de todos os parâmetros físico-químicos avaliados. A taxa de recuperação de água na unidade de OR foi de 74,64%.

Os ensaios teóricos contidos em *Pedagogia do Oprimido* fundamentam-se na articulação entre teoria e prática, inovando o campo educacional ao vincular a práxis à libertação humana mediante o diálogo, a reflexão crítica, a conscientização e a ação transformadora sobre a realidade. Este artigo, de natureza teórico-bibliográfica, objetivou identificar e analisar os significados da categoria práxis na obra de Paulo Freire. Em diálogo com os referenciais de Sánchez Vázquez (1977), Marx (2007) e Konder (1992), constatou-se a centralidade da dimensão política na conceituação freireana de práxis, figurando como elemento articulador da conscientização e orientador da ação humana sobre a realidade concreta. A práxis em Freire compreende a práxis histórica e social estruturada sobre a tríade: transformação de uma realidade injusta, crítica reflexiva fundamentada e conhecimento rigoroso do mundo.

Objetivo: analisar a associação entre a percepção de apoio social e a presença de sintomas emocionais e físicos associados a transtornos mentais comuns em mulheres. Método: estudo transversal e quantitativo, realizado com amostra aleatória de 141 mulheres cadastradas em uma Unidade de Saúde da Família em Ribeirão Preto, SP. Utilizaram-se um questionário sociodemográfico, o Questionário de Suporte Social (SSQ) e o *Self-Reporting Questionnaire* (SRQ-20). Resultados: não se observou associação estatística direta entre variáveis sociodemográficas e a presença de transtornos mentais, embora a menor renda e a baixa escolaridade tenham se destacado no perfil das sintomáticas. O exercício de ocupações de baixo prestígio social suscitou reflexões sobre as iniquidades de gênero. Verificou-se diferença significativa nos escores de satisfação com o apoio social entre as mulheres que relataram ou não sintomas de fadiga e tristeza, bem como na dimensão numérica da rede de apoio entre as que referiram fadiga. Cônjuges e filhos foram apontados como os principais provedores de suporte; contudo, a presença de transtorno mental associou-se significativamente à ausência de amigos na rede interpessoal. Conclusão: a equidade de gênero e a satisfação com o suporte social constituem elementos determinantes na atenção à saúde. A promoção da saúde mental feminina requer o fortalecimento dos vínculos comunitários e da rede de suporte afetivo.

A reavaliação historiográfica da figura de Ivan Sollertínski (1902–1944) permanece como uma demanda em aberto na musicologia ocidental contemporânea, que sistematicamente negligenciou a análise aprofundada de sua produção crítica e de seu projeto ideológico-cognitivo. A escassez de fontes primárias, as barreiras linguísticas e a restrita circulação de seus textos contribuíram para uma recepção fragmentada de seu legado. A obra ensaística e de divulgação de Sollertínski articula análises estéticas e epistemológicas aplicadas à estruturação artístico-compositiva. Este artigo examina a influência do eixo conceitual Sollertínski–Bakhtin nas composições da primeira fase de Dmitri Shostakovich, nas quais a simbologia crítico-literária permite identificar modelos cognitivo-perceptivos de matriz dostoievskiana e shakespeareana, além de elementos da cultura popular carnavalesca (Rabelais), alheios aos preceitos estéticos do Realismo Socialista. Analisam-se obras de Shostakovich que se projetam sobre domínios extramusicais, revelando uma linguagem articulada à teoria bakhtiniana ao longo de um período de cerca de dez anos. Essa produção musical incorpora léxicos e estruturas sintáticas oriundas da crítica literária em um arranjo interdisciplinar caracterizado pela intertextualidade estrutural. O método crítico tripartite-detotalizante (*tripartitico detotalizzante*), formulado por Sollertínski, consolida-se como ferramenta analítico-historiográfica para a interpretação da arquitetônica composicional e do projeto estilístico do período.

The Serra da Bocaina National Park is located between the States of São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, being the only PARNA in the State of São Paulo. A total of 485 species of bryophytes were found, with Lejeuneaceae being the family with the highest species richness, comprising 93 species. For mosses, the family Bryaceae presented 23 species. We found 47 species as new records for the State of São Paulo. Among all collected species, 43% are restricted to the Atlantic Forest, 31% are endemic to Brazil, and 155 species are rare in Brazil. These numbers show the importance of this Park for the preservation of bryophyte species in the country and for future studies in the area.

The strong dependence on timber from species of the genera Eucalyptus and Pinus, combined with the search for products of different qualities, drives studies on alternative woods for industrial purposes, mainly from species of the Caatinga biome, which is little studied for forestry purposes. The objective of this study was to chemically characterize the wood of the species Pterogyne nitens, as well as to analyze its potential for cellulosic pulp production. Three representative 9-year-old trees were harvested in an experimental plantation located at the State University of Southwest Bahia - Vitória da Conquista Campus, and five stem sections were sampled between the positions of 0, 25, 50, 75, and 100% of the commercial height. The logs were converted into chips and homogenized into a representative composite sample for basic density analysis and complete chemical composition, as well as for Kraft pulping (five cooks using different effective alkali charges aiming at a Kappa Number of 18). The basic density of Pterogyne nitens wood was 641 kg/m3, and its chemical composition showed 41.9% cellulose, 24.7% hemicelluloses, 26.5% lignin, 7.3% extractives, and 0.5% ash. The cooking yield for Kappa Number 18 was 46.4% and viscosity was 1075 dm3/kg. The species did not prove to be an interesting alternative for cellulosic pulp production (low cellulose content and screened yield), but it is very promising for application in the wood energy sector.

The article discusses the reuse of the ancient past in later times, a defining characteristic of different cultures and eras. To understand these processes of reuse, two terms are frequently used: "reception" and "uses of the past." In dialogue with international scholarship in the field, Brazilian studies on reception and uses of the past have developed remarkably, particularly through the contributions of key figures such as Francisco Murari Pires, Pedro Paulo Abreu Funari, and José Antônio Dabdab Trabulsi. The formation and establishment of these fields have occurred primarily within the scope of the Ancient History Working Group of the National History Association (GTHA-Anpuh), manifesting in various publications by Brazilian authors in Brazil and abroad. Beyond analyzing this dynamic in Ancient History studies and the definitions, overlaps, and distinctions between reception and uses of the past, this article also addresses the specific case of Curitiba and the presence of Greco-Roman Antiquity in the city, as an example within Brazilian history.

The objective was to evaluate the mycotoxicological and nutritional variables of corn hybrids with different characteristics that influence feed cost for broilers. Twenty-six genetically modified corn hybrids were evaluated in the 2016 and 2017 second crop seasons (safrinhas), featuring different germplasms, endosperm textures, and cycle lengths. The hybrids were evaluated for damaged grains, fumonisins (B1+B2) (FUM), aflatoxins (B1+B2+G1+G2) (AFLA), zearalenone (ZEA), deoxynivalenol (DON), moisture, crude protein (CP), nitrogen-corrected apparent metabolizable energy (AMEn), digestible amino acids for poultry (lysine, methionine, cystine, and threonine), and the respective cost of the starter broiler feed, calculated by least-cost formulation. The prevalence of FUM, AFLA, ZEA, and DON was 90, 17, 33, and 0%, with averages of 3067, 1, 38, and 0 µg/kg across the two years, respectively. The average AMEn and CP were 3264 kcal/kg and 8.02%, respectively, and differed (P<0.05) between the two years. Feed cost was significantly influenced (P<0.05) by FUM, CP, and AMEn in both years. Hybrids with Viptera technology present lower FUM concentrations and lower feed costs. Early-cycle hybrids show lower FUM concentrations, higher percentages of CP and digestible amino acids, and lower feed costs.

In this article, my objective is to analyze the production of 'prestige', reputation, and memory among cowboys (vaqueiros) in the backcountry (sertão) of Pernambuco, based on their relationships with the body, animals, and territory. To this end, I demonstrate that the exaltation of a life of sacrifice and the tasks related to the cowboy's craft result from their various practices and knowledge, but also from their rhetorical ability to narrate and reconstruct past events. In the practices known as 'pega de boi' (cattle catching), cowboys, animals, and the caatinga vegetation emerge as beings in dispute, striving to triumph over one another. To analyze these practices, the ethnographic material I draw upon consists of narratives from an 'old cowboy' whose particularity in orally crafting his past experiences expresses all at once the importance of the body, memory, and animals in the daily life of cowboys.

Collaborative writing is performed with the participation of writers in shared authorship. The characteristics of collaborative writing—such as the group reaching premature consensus, poor communication, and a member not seeing another's work—generate stylistic differences and uncoordinated edits that cause coherence issues. The objective is to verify the maintenance of the discursive topic in a review written collaboratively on a wiki portal by high school students. The hypothesis was that maintaining the discursive topic in collaborative writing would be more demanding for the participating writers, as it requires group consensus negotiation. The maintenance of the discursive topic was verified, and an interview was conducted with the group for data analysis. The results point to a cause-and-effect relationship between the characteristics of collaborative writing and topic maintenance, which impaired the production of coherence in the review.

The theoretical perspective of this text is that of Discourse Analysis in dialogue with the Semantics of the Event. The film The Photographer of Mauthausen is taken as the object of analysis. The film narrates the story of Francesc Boix, a former Spanish Civil War soldier imprisoned in the Mauthausen concentration camp in Austria during World War II. We seek to understand how the film's narrative speaks of the political and the subject's resistance. The political is the conflict in language because the real is divided unequally. The political is inscribed in diverse signifier materialities within the film: in the smuggling of everyday objects, in the tricks to hide incriminating evidence, in language, and in the body itself. By resisting, subjects can disrupt discourse and constitute other meanings and other subject-positions. This is what the signifier materialities show: the refusal to assume solely the identity of prisoner imposed upon them.

In this study, a statistical downscaling model (SDM) based on the analogue methodology was used to project future precipitation and temperature patterns in the city of Maceió, eastern coast of Northeastern Brazil (9.7° S; 35.7° W; 64.5 m), and evaluate their impacts on sugarcane yield. Historical observed data were used to downscale precipitation and temperature using different global climate models (CanESM2, CNRM-CM5, IPSL-CM5A-MR, GFDL-ESM2M, MIROC-ESM, MPI-ESM-MR, and NorESM1-M) relative to the baseline period (1961–1990), and subsequently for future scenarios from 2021 to 2080. Data were analyzed in 10-day periods (decads), the same time step as the agrometeorological model used for the crop. Contrary to expectations, the combination of reduced rainfall and increased evapotranspiration in future scenarios did not decrease the estimated yield, which is predicted to increase. This fact can be attributed to the finding that the predicted reduction in rainfall, more pronounced in the rainy season, will not be decisive for a yield decline, since most climate models project an increase in rainfall during the dry period from September to December, which is critical for early crop growth under a planting calendar starting in the first decad of September.

Juglans regia and Carya illinoinensis, both belonging to the Juglandaceae family, are walnut species known worldwide for producing edible nuts, with an expanding cultivated area in South America. However, in recent years there has been an increased incidence of diseases in these species, which compromises crop profitability and product quality. Colletotrichum nymphaeae was recently identified in Brazil causing damage to Juglans regia fruits. This study aimed to evaluate the cross-infection potential of C. nymphaeae, isolated from symptomatic Juglans regia fruits, on leaflets and fruits of Carya illinoinensis cultivars. For this purpose, culture medium discs containing pathogen structures were placed on leaflets and fruits of six and three Carya illinoinensis cultivars, respectively. Colletotrichum nymphaeae proved to be pathogenic to both leaflets and fruits of all evaluated cultivars, with the largest lesions on leaflets observed in cultivars 'Barton', 'Melhorada', and 'Imperial', whereas cultivar 'Shawnee' showed lower susceptibility to the pathogen. On fruits, cultivar 'Imperial' was the most susceptible to the pathogen, presenting the largest lesions.

This article aims to analyze the perception of members of internal and external control bodies in public management regarding the role of the State Health Council in the accountability of Social Health Organizations. This is an analytical study with a qualitative approach, based on semi-structured interviews with an intentional sample. Ten key actors responsible for internal and external control mechanisms of the Unified Health System (SUS) were selected. The data revealed the Council's role regarding Social Health Organizations, which consists of overseeing the management of these organizations as representatives of society. Acting transparently, as well as enabling accountability by Social Organizations using appropriate language for Council members, in addition to political independence and freedom to monitor health actions, are premises that must be met for the monitoring process to be more effective and proactive in the view of these institutional actors.

This article seeks to problematize the advancement of the ultra-neoliberal model present in the Bolsonaro government and its impacts on Brazilian social security policy, as a public policy and, as such, a duty of the State. The advance of reactionary counter-reforms destroys the essential pillars of social security policy: health, social security, and social assistance. The chosen methodology consists of bibliographical research based on scientific publications in articles and books, as well as newspapers and magazines on the topic. The ultra-neoliberal agenda imposes an unprecedented persecution of historically conquered rights. In times of the COVID-19 pandemic, the contradictions of the policy of denial of rights become evident. Bolsonarism has implemented necropolitics as official policy, which stems from an authoritarian control over defining who should die and who deserves to live, further deepening social barbarism against the working class.

Seed coat and water content can interfere with seed tolerance to thermal shocks, as can their environment of origin. To test these possibilities, seeds of Plathymenia reticulata and Stryphnodendron adstringens were collected in northern Minas Gerais State (representing dry savanna) and northeastern Mato Grosso State (representing humid savanna) of the Cerrado biome, and their responses to thermal shocks of 110, 140, and 170 ºC for 2.5 minutes were evaluated under different conditions: intact, scarified, and imbibed after scarification. Scarified and imbibed seeds germinated faster for both species. Dry savanna seeds presented lower initial water content and slower germination for both species, but higher tolerance to thermal shocks than humid savanna seeds. P. reticulata seeds did not survive after the 140 ºC treatment, but dry savanna S. adstringens seeds endured the 170 ºC treatment, regardless of whether they were scarified and/or imbibed. It is concluded that P. reticulata seeds are less tolerant to thermal shocks than S. adstringens seeds, that dry seeds are more tolerant to thermal shocks than imbibed seeds, and that seeds from dry savannas are more tolerant to thermal shocks than seeds from humid environments.

This article presents a discussion on the relationship between territoriality and intersectionality based on the experience of Brazilian Black women throughout the historical process that triggered a long trajectory of struggle against racism and sexism. Bibliographical and documentary research was used to address the territories of the body, the home, and the city, understood as spaces of oppression and resistance. These analytical categories have received considerable attention, especially within the Black feminist movement; however, few studies explicitly and thoroughly address the relationship between intersectionality and territoriality anchored in an expanded conception of territory that extends from the body to the city. Thinking about these concepts together and in a multiscalar manner can contribute to giving greater visibility to the spaces of agency of Brazilian Black women in the struggle for reparation, recognition, and the right to exist.

Currently, several mortars are available for application in the construction industry. These mortars can be based on different binders, possess different physical and mechanical properties, and even other specific properties. However, selecting the correct mortar is becoming increasingly difficult. Thus, there is a need to classify different mortars based on specific criteria and a single procedure. In this way, it will be possible to identify the most appropriate mortars according to their function. In this work, a material classification procedure developed by Czarnecki and Lukowski based on a usability function was used. The classification procedure transforms experimental results of several properties into a single numerical value. In this way, construction products can be classified according to their individual properties or an optimized combination of several properties. Thus, the main objective of this study is the classification of mortars based on different binders incorporated with phase change materials (PCM). The studied binders were hydraulic lime, gypsum, and cement. For each binder, three distinct mortars were developed: a reference mortar (0% PCM), a mortar with 40% PCM incorporation, and a mortar with 40% PCM incorporation and 1% fibers. Based on the results, it was possible to conclude that the incorporation of PCM affects the overall performance of the mortars.

Background Doxorubicin is associated with cardiotoxicity and late cardiac morbidity. Heme is related to cellular oxidative stress. However, its specific regulation in cardiomyocytes under the effects of doxorubicin has not yet been documented. Objective Our objective is to evaluate changes in rate-limiting enzymes in the heme metabolic pathway under the effect of doxorubicin. Methods H9c2 cardiomyocytes were treated with doxorubicin at different concentrations (1, 2, 5, 10 μM, respectively). Real-time PCR and Western Blot assays were used to determine protein and mRNA expression for four crucial enzymes (ALAS1, ALAS2, HOX-1, and HOX-2) that regulate cellular heme metabolism, and heme levels were detected by ELISA. A p < 0.01 was considered significant. Results We observed a dose-dependent alteration pattern in heme levels in H9c2 cells, with the highest level at a doxorubicin concentration of 5 μM, which occurred synchronously with the highest level of upregulation of ALAS1 as well as the degenerative enzymes HOX-1 and HOX-2 in protein and mRNA expression. In contrast, we observed that ALAS2 was gradually downregulated, inversely proportional to doxorubicin concentrations. Conclusion Increased ALAS1 expression may play a role in elevating heme levels when H9c2 cardiomyocytes are exposed to doxorubicin and may be a therapeutic target for doxorubicin-induced myocardial toxicity. (Arq Bras Cardiol. 2021; 116(2):315-322)

This study aimed to map intense rainfall events with durations of 10, 30, 720, and 1440 minutes, associated with return periods of 10, 50, and 100 years, for the State of Tocantins. Historical series from 95 rain gauge stations located in Tocantins State and surrounding areas were applied, covering a standardized period from 1983 to 2013. A geostatistical study was conducted, evaluating spherical, exponential, and Gaussian semivariogram models fitted by the weighted least squares method. From this study, the model presenting the lowest mean error based on cross-validation was applied to the mapping process by ordinary kriging. Geostatistical techniques performed well, highlighting the spherical model for mapping annual maximum daily rainfall, and the Gaussian model for rainfall calculated using the disaggregation methodology. It was also verified that the areas with the occurrence of the most severe intense rainfall in the state are located in Bico do Papagaio (north), Ilha do Bananal (southwest), and the northwestern region of the state.

Abdominal aortic aneurysm rupture is an event with high mortality, and its treatment in these cases is a medical emergency. Endovascular treatment of these aneurysms has established itself as a minimally invasive alternative to classic open surgery, becoming the first-choice option. However, 20% to 50% of patients with abdominal aortic aneurysm do not present favorable anatomy for endovascular treatment due to the presence of a short neck or involvement of visceral branches by the aneurysm. We report the case of a 70-year-old female patient who underwent endovascular repair of a ruptured juxtarenal aneurysm with parallel stent implantation to the renal arteries (chimney technique). Clinical data and procedural details are presented. Technical success was achieved, and no postoperative complications were reported.

The objective of this work was to test the viability of using the vaginal route in female cattle for oxytocin administration using specific formulations. Oxytocin was used associated with absorption enhancers and in injectable form (for comparison). Seven formulations were produced, all with a concentration of 5 IU/mL of oxytocin. The experimental design was an 8x8 Latin square (eight days, eight treatments, and eight cycling heifers). Oxytocin administrations were via the vaginal route, and injectable oxytocin was administered intravenously, each containing 10 IU. Blood samples (n=7) were collected from each animal at time 0, prior to treatment administration, and every three minutes up to 18 minutes. Oxytocin was extracted from plasma using a C-18 chromatographic column and quantified using the commercial Oxytocin EIA kit. The obtained results were evaluated by non-parametric statistical analysis using the Kruskal-Wallis test for mean comparisons. Oxytocin concentration differed between time 0 and time 12 minutes (p<0.05) for the oxytocin in glycerin formulation. It was concluded that absorption occurred through the vaginal route for this formulation. Further studies will be necessary for its effective use in cattle management.

The spaces occupied by discussions in the curriculum say a lot about the intentionality and interests surrounding the guiding documents of Brazilian education. In view of this, and based on the theoretical framework related to complex thinking and critical Environmental Education, this study addresses the identification of the space occupied by environmental education in the National Common Curricular Base (BNCC) and in the National Common Base for Initial and Continuing Training of Basic Education Teachers (BNC-Formação). Through documentary research and in light of Discursive Textual Analysis, it is analyzed that what actually emerges in the mentioned documents is a non-place for environmental education, thus converging toward the silencing of the precepts of critical Environmental Education in Basic and Higher Education, the latter regarding degree courses. In this sense, the results revealed that socio-environmental discussion is subject to generalization in the BNCC and invisibilization in the BNC-Formação, thereby demonstrating how such documents configure themselves as instruments of a training that reproduces the interests of the dominant order and the status quo, rooted in the simplistic and fragmenting paradigm of knowledge production, which precludes a critical and complex perception of reality.

When Silviano Santiago published his essay on Latin American discursivity in the 1970s, the theoretical and political conjuncture was marked by a critique of structuralism and by the formation of a historical bloc that, in the following decade, would participate in the constituent process: the beginning of a cycle. The intention of this article is to rethink such discursivity considering that the 2020 conjuncture updates some of those debates linked to geo-economic dependence. Passing through the recent archive of Casa de Rui Barbosa and through poems by Marília Garcia, Ana Estaregui, and Priscilla Menezes, I propose to question a relationship between ways of reading the archive and the land, or between reading pedagogies and extractive practices. In the footsteps of Santiago's debates, read with Josefina Ludmer, we can position the emergence of an expanded concept of extraction that allows us to reflect on some variations in Latin American discourse.

This article presents two sections that, although distinct, are connected by a common object: the novel A Senhora de Pangim, by the Brazilian Integralist author Gustavo Barroso, published in Brazil in 1932 and in Portugal in 1940. The first section analyzes studies of historical and literary background published between 1932 and 1965. The second section analyzes graphic representations of the historical character Baltasar do Couto Cardoso/Maria Úrsula de Abreu e Lencastro (1682-1730), focusing especially on two comic books: the Brazilian Edição Maravilhosa, no. 116, published in 1956, and the Mexican Mujeres Célebres, no. 57, published in 1965. We are interested not only in reflecting on the reiterations and ruptures between historical and literary discourse, but also in discussing warrior-maidens and the way these representations considered the character's gender instability.

Introduction: Burns represent one of the most severe traumatic injuries, and their treatment requires a multidisciplinary approach in which the role of the plastic surgeon is essential. Restoring the protective function of the skin while recovering the aesthetics of the burned area are challenging goals that the plastic surgeon aims to achieve. Case Report: A 27-year-old female patient underwent mastopexy with implant insertion, in which the skin removed from the breast was used to perform a full-thickness skin graft in the mandibular and submental region for scar treatment. The patient achieved complete graft integration, with no evidence of epidermolysis areas. The aesthetic results were excellent, achieving patient satisfaction and improvement in dyschromic and hypertrophic scar areas. Conclusion: Autologous grafting using breast skin constitutes a good alternative for treating facial burn sequelae, enabling excellent aesthetic results.

This study analyzes how audio description—a modality of intersemiotic translation—and sensory visits can constitute a framework to make theatrical art accessible to visually impaired spectators. The research, qualitative in nature and developed under the assumptions of action research (MONCEAU, 2005), reports the stages of an experience conducted in the state of Espírito Santo to enable this audience to achieve aesthetic enjoyment of a theatrical performance through their remaining senses (KOEHLER, 2017). It develops discussions on cultural accessibility (SARRAF, 2018), dialogism, and exotopy (BAKHTIN, 1997, 2002), and anchors the understanding of blind people's perception based on analyses by Joana Belarmino (2009), PhD in Communication and Semiotics. It concludes that the process of planning and executing audio description and sensory visits in a live artistic event demands methodological, exotopic, and dialogic rigor, with responsive and multilateral attitudes, as opposed to improvisation and solitary action. Furthermore, it asserts that perceiving the world, for visually impaired people, proposes continuous exercises involving the body, space, and events, consisting of an aesthetic activity.

The Itapeva State Park (PEVA) is a full protection Conservation Unit located on the northern coast of the State of Rio Grande do Sul, whose main objective is the preservation of natural ecosystems of great ecological relevance and scenic beauty, such as dunes, wetlands, swamp forests, and restinga forests, remnants of the Atlantic Forest. Aiming to survey the bryophytes present in PEVA, a floristic survey was conducted through random walk sampling, resulting in the identification of 101 species, 46 genera, and 31 families. Among the sampled phytophysiognomies, the sandy restinga forest over rocky outcrop was the most expressive, with 70 identified species. Fourteen species represent new records for the State of Rio Grande do Sul, seven of which are new records for southern Brazil. The results indicate that PEVA is an important conservation area that preserves biodiversity, demonstrating the need for further floristic studies in the State, especially along the Coast.

In this article, we aim to understand the discourses that compose the historical-social condition of a mistress. To this end, we seek to reflect on how a woman in an extramarital relationship ethically-discursively constructs society's view regarding her romantic condition. Situated within the field of Applied Linguistics, we seek to interpret the historicity of discursive acts and the impact of these acts on the representation of subjectivities through the analysis of the surrounding discourses present therein. In light of this, we consider studies on the dialogic relations of discourse and active responsive understanding from the so-called Bakhtin Circle. The results point to a discourse that retrieves the notion of the mistress as subservient, dependent, guilty, and a home-wrecker. Despite these connotations, the interviewee demonstrates a relevant degree of active responsivity by renaming and, consequently, re-signifying her romantic condition.

OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the effect of a warm shower bath and perineal exercise with a Swiss ball, isolated and in combination, on the perception of pain, anxiety, and labor progression. METHOD: A randomized controlled clinical trial with 128 laboring women allocated into three therapy groups: shower bath, Swiss ball, isolated and combined. Pain perception and anxiety were evaluated before and thirty minutes after the therapeutic intervention using a visual analog scale (VAS). RESULTS: There was an increase in pain score and a reduction in anxiety in all groups, especially when using a shower bath. Cervical dilation increased in all intervention groups (p<.001), as did the number of uterine contractions, mainly among those who used the shower bath and ball in combination, which also showed a shorter duration of labor. CONCLUSION: The studied therapies contribute to maternal adaptation and well-being and favor labor progression.

Although the topics of maturity levels in corporate environmental management and the adoption of GSCM practices are becoming consolidated, they have so far followed long, disconnected paths, even though both have their genesis circumscribed to corporate sustainability. Through multiple cases, we sought to characterize a logical pattern of adopting GSCM practices inherent to each maturity level in environmental management. Based on the study of five cases of companies operating in production chains with high environmental impact (agricultural defense supply sector, battery sector, and lead recycling sector), we sought to identify the relationship between Green Supply Chain Management (GSCM) practices and maturity levels in environmental management. To achieve this objective, a systematization was carried out alongside the literature dealing with environmental management maturity and the typology of GSCM practices. The main results indicate that: at the first level of environmental management maturity (reactive), organizations adopt specific GSCM practices related to legal compliance; at the preventive level of environmental management maturity, organizations adopt GSCM practices related to return on investment and reduction of operational costs; and at the proactive level of environmental management maturity, organizations tend to adopt practices related to product and process innovation as well as environmental communication practices, aiming to obtain competitive advantages based on environmental management. To date, this article represents the first research linking levels of environmental management maturity to GSCM practices applied to five high environmental impact cases in Brazil.

Anaximander occupies a prominent place in the history of philosophy, according to Thomas Aquinas's In De Caelo, because, in the light of rationality, he discovered the boundary points of the cosmos from the observer's perspective, namely: the stars and the Earth—the two items through which the Milesian inaugurated philosophical cosmology and cosmography. This study shows that, based not only on Aristotle's text but also on other doxographical sources, notably Simplicius's In De Caelo, Thomas gathers in his text cosmological theories attributed to Anaximander, such as geocentrism, the finitude of the cosmos, and the infinitude and divinity of the ruler of the whole; reflecting upon them, the author manifests the grandiosity of the genius of the philosopher considered to be the successor of Thales of Miletus.

Orchidaceae is the largest family of vascular plants and constitutes a group under intense threat due to anthropogenic activities. Cattleya caulescens and C. endsfeldzii are rock-dwelling (rupicolous) species endemic to Minas Gerais, Brazil, and appear on state and national red lists of threatened species. Therefore, morphoanatomical studies were conducted to expand knowledge on these taxa, given the potential these studies hold for species management. Cattleya caulescens and C. endsfeldzii exhibit strong morphoanatomical similarities, supporting previous studies that place both in the same section of the genus. Several anatomical characteristics described here (uniseriate epidermis, hypostomatic leaf, large primary pit fields in the photosynthetic parenchyma, and root anatomy) are common to several other Orchidaceae species. The observed xeromorphic characters are related to edaphoclimatic conditions, as they occur on rocky substrates with constant solar exposure and severe water restriction during most of the year. This work contributes to broadening the knowledge of the genus Cattleya and aiding in the taxonomic delimitation of these threatened species occurring in areas of intense anthropogenic activity.

The general objective of this study was to analyze the physical characteristics of Mesoscale Convective Complexes (MCC) in the Northeast region of Brazil between 2008 and 2017. To create short-term weather forecasts, it is necessary to understand and detail these systems, as MCCs frequently cause adverse phenomena leading to socioeconomic losses for society as a whole. Case identification and selection, as well as all calculations of their physical characteristics, were carried out using an automated MCC detection and analysis algorithm based on the criteria proposed by Maddox. METEOSAT satellite images in the enhanced infrared channel were used as input data for the algorithm. A total of 65 systems were identified, occurring mainly during the autumn and summer seasons. The MCCs began developing between late evening and early morning (between 00 and 03 UTC). There was an interval of approximately four hours between genesis and maximum development, when they reach their maximum spatial coverage. The average coverage area of these MCCs was approximately 120,000 km2, with a recorded case reaching a total area of around 427,926 km2.

Meteorological systems that cause storms accompanied by strong winds, such as cold fronts and extratropical and subtropical cyclones, often interfere with sea state conditions. Consequently, sea levels can rise extraordinarily, causing coastal flooding. The years 2015 and 2016 were characterized by the occurrence of the positive phase of the El Niño - Southern Oscillation phenomenon, with very strong intensity. Southern Brazil exhibited higher atmospheric instability conditions, with frequent passages of frontal systems and formation of extratropical cyclones, interfering with sea conditions along the Southern and Southeastern coasts of Brazil. Given the above, this study aimed to evaluate atmospheric conditions during storm surge events on the Southern and Southeastern coasts of Brazil during the 2015/2016 El Niño, using information from Bad Weather Warnings issued by the Brazilian Navy Hydrographic Center. Through these warnings and ERA-Interim reanalysis data, distributions by maritime area, month, and season were analyzed, and surface-plotted synoptic fields were analyzed for the 12 most prominent events. As results, the autumn and winter months recorded the highest occurrences of storm surges in both areas during the 2015/2016 El Niño period. Overall, four atmospheric patterns favorable to storm surge events were identified, based on the activity of extratropical cyclones and post-frontal high-pressure systems.

This article presents part of the research results of a master's thesis seeking to deepen reflections on librarians' practices and identify their perceptions and meanings regarding professional performance and the academic library within the context of cyberculture. The study was conducted in a medical university library, presenting the trajectory and characteristics of this library and identifying, based on semi-structured interviews conducted with eight active or retired librarians, the meanings attributed to librarian practices. The narratives reveal a constant search for professional recognition and appreciation, as well as a concern with maintaining user attendance at the physical space of the studied library. Among the perceived changes in this role, it is noted that the sense of "mediator" gives way to the sense of "educator," and the stance of "waiting for the user" gives way to "reaching out to the user," reflecting an apprehension regarding the future of the library and the librarian's role. Likewise, meanings were identified that may indicate strategies for maintaining professional culture and remaining in the labor market.

The evolution of the rural population and animals of some native Portuguese breeds has shown concerning levels of decline, with environmental and ecological consequences for territorial management, planning, and sustainability, particularly regarding the socioeconomic dimension and territorial cohesion itself. In this work, based on interviews conducted with breeders, companies, and associations dedicated to raising and protecting the Garrano equine breed—used for various purposes—we aim to identify the benefits of adopting a farming system that includes the Garrano, while also highlighting its main weaknesses. The approach is developed considering the environmental, economic, and social dimensions of sustainability. The results highlight the importance of these animals, not only as living genetic heritage, but also in wildfire defense, specifically in fuel biomass control. However, it will be necessary to define a concerted strategy to enhance their contribution to the economy of farms or enterprises, which should be reflected in increased population well-being, stabilization of the animal herd, and territorial sustainability.

The State of Ceará stands out in the wind energy production process due to its privileged geographical location for wind power generation. This work aims to present the environmental, social, economic, and technological impacts arising from the implementation and operation of Wind Farms on the Ceará coast through a comparative analysis between the Beberibe and Fleixeiras I Wind Farms. The main socio-environmental impacts detected were: reduction of fauna and flora, wear of access roads, noise production, decharacterization of the natural landscape, restriction of the right to free movement, and cracks in houses. Economic impacts were more pronounced during wind farm construction, gradually decreasing over the years. Regarding technological aspects, it was observed that the greater the tower height and rotor diameter, the greater the amount of energy generated. This investigation was descriptive and exploratory in nature, describing impacts using qualitative and quantitative methods. Directed studies were necessary to understand the impacts caused by wind energy sources and to suggest alternatives to mitigate the worsening of climate change caused by the greenhouse effect on the planet.

The article examines the actions of the Public Prosecutor's Office and the Court of Accounts of the State of Rio Grande do Sul within the framework of the national early childhood education policy, especially regarding the expansion of places in public schools. The axes of analysis, researched through document analysis and interviews with prosecutors, auditors, and municipal managers, encompassed the characteristics of their actions, organizational changes, and interaction among external control bodies. The results demonstrate that these bodies act not merely as supervisors, but directly influence early childhood education policies as co-administrators (Hoffmann and Bentes 2008) or fixers (Bardach 1977; Sabatier and Mazmanian 1993; Weimer and Vining 2017) of their implementation by municipalities. It was also observed that these accountability institutions have gradually assumed new roles in the field of education since the 2000s, following a path of incremental development (Mahoney and Thelen 2009) marked by a variety of actions, including inter-institutional cooperation.

There are many challenges to closing the gaps between scientific evidence and better health outcomes. Knowledge translation (KT) is the movement that knowledge makes within an organizational context toward its effective application. The objective of this study was to analyze the occurrence of KT at the Executive Secretariat for Health Surveillance of Pernambuco (SEVS/PE), taking as its object ten evaluative studies on Health Surveillance programs produced in the Master's Program in Health Evaluation at the Instituto de Medicina Integral Prof. Fernando Figueira from 2011 to 2015. For this purpose, a semi-structured interview script was used, addressing seven managers and ten technical staff members from SEVS-PE. In analyzing this qualitative case study, a KT model was utilized, overlaid with an evaluation use-influence theoretical framework. In eight analyzed studies, evidence was categorized across five stages of KT. Only the stage evaluating knowledge use was not evidenced. Different types of use, dimensions, and levels of evaluation influence were reported. Among the changes that occurred, respondents reported: creation of new agendas, development of protocols, changes in work processes, institution of new workflows, and hiring of new professionals.

This article analyzes the road safety of federal highways located in urban areas in Southern Brazil. It evaluates the occurrence of casualties based on records from the Federal Highway Police (PRF), combined with pavement conditions, road geometry, and traffic signage, according to the methodology of the National Confederation of Transport (CNT). Critical urban stretches were highlighted using geoprocessing software, and accident delineation relied on concepts based on the Safe System approach, which posits that traffic accidents, when they occur, should not lead to severe or fatal injuries. When considering fatalities and seriously injured victims, urban stretches of federal highways in the Southern region were among the most dangerous in Brazil. Most highways in urban areas were classified as "good" regarding state of conservation, but several segments concentrated a high number of casualties, predominantly involving motorcycles. As a negative highlight, São José in Santa Catarina presented the most critical stretch. Of the segments with high accident rates, almost all were located near major urban agglomerations or regional capitals, likely due to the high volume of trips generated by socioeconomic activities.

The family Cactaceae includes 1,850 species distributed primarily across the Americas, with Brazil being the third largest center of diversity for the family, housing 277 species. Within this latter diversity center, the Boa Nova National Park (PNBN), located in eastern Bahia State, Brazil, covers an area of approximately 12,065 ha, including an east-west ecotone where Atlantic Forest areas are replaced by vine forest (mata-de-cipó) and, further west, by Caatinga. As part of the proposal for the 2011 National Action Plan for Cactaceae Conservation, this study presents a taxonomic survey of Cactaceae occurring in the PNBN, aiming to expand knowledge of the local flora and Conservation Units in Bahia State. Material was collected during four sampling expeditions over one year along random trails traversing the park's diverse environments. A total of 10 genera and 15 species were recorded: Arrojadoa penicillata, Brasilicereus phaeacanthus, Brasiliopuntia brasiliensis, Cereus jamacaru, Cereus sp., Melocactus ernestii, Pereskia aculeata, P. bahiensis, Pilosocereus catingicola, P. pentaedrophorus subsp. robustus, Rhipsalis hileiabaiana, R. russellii, Stephanocereus leucostele, Tacinga funalis, and T. werneri. Within the PNBN, vine forest and Caatinga vegetations presented the highest species richness, with eight and five species, respectively, whereas the Atlantic Forest contained a single species.

This article proposes an analysis of the issue of disease and death in artistic representations within painting collections in Belém do Pará between the late 19th and early 20th centuries. To this end, it proposes a transversal reading based on questions raised in the present during the COVID-19 pandemic as a comparative heuristic resource. It aims to establish a dialogue between present and past through images, potencies, reverberations, discursive records, and museum exhibitions. Thus, diseases depicted in painting, such as cancer and tuberculosis, seen within the framework of Belle Époque epidemics, are now analyzed not only within the framework of present-day pandemic comorbidities, but also as a cognitive repertoire of the very history and memory of images in the Amazon.

Considering the particleboard industry, the majority utilizes synthetic adhesives, especially urea-formaldehyde-based ones; in this regard, studies encompassing the characteristics of alternative materials for the panel industry become important, particularly when considering the final cost of generated products. The overall objective of this study was to evaluate changes in the chemical structure of the adhesive that could cause possible modifications in its bonding properties due to the replacement of urea-formaldehyde adhesive with lignosulfonate. For this purpose, the elemental chemical composition of lignosulfonate and its chemical bonds were determined using infrared (IR) and nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, both pure and in combination with different catalysts; the properties of urea-formaldehyde and its modifications, such as pH, viscosity, and gelation time, were also evaluated. NMR analysis of lignosulfonate showed the typical pattern generally obtained for lignin derivatives in their chemical bonds. Elemental chemical analysis revealed high contents of Mg, Ca, and Na. The addition of lignosulfonate to urea-formaldehyde caused acidification of the adhesive and a reduction in viscosity values. Gelation time was also affected; however, it was found that the methodology for this type of polymer must be readjusted relative to the traditional method, subjecting it to temperatures above 90 °C. Results led to the conclusion that lignosulfonate can be used as a replacement for urea-formaldehyde adhesive in particleboard production.

The objective of the article is to highlight the potential role of student exchange agencies as immigration facilitators. Aiming to understand consumer behavior and the factors motivating Brazilians to immigrate to Australia, the researchers conducted a survey with 608 consumers connected to 10 Facebook groups representing Brazilian communities in Australia. Through a logistic regression model, the researchers chose the study's dependent variable to be represented by the permanent immigrant, assigning a value of 0 (zero) if respondents did not intend to live in Australia permanently, or 1 (one) otherwise. The independent variables, representing factors present at the time of arrival in the country that might affect the decision to immigrate permanently, were gender, age at arrival, future entrepreneurial intention, student visa, and educational level. The results point to statistically significant factors related to immigration to Australia based on the sociodemographic profiles of the respondents. In-depth interviews were also conducted with a travel agent and Brazilian residents. As practical implications, the article highlights consumer behavior, motivations for immigration, and factors leading to the hiring of student exchange agencies.

Although Araliaceae includes many species with leaf margins featuring serrated teeth, the anatomical structure of these projections has never been investigated. Thus, this study aimed to characterize the leaf tooth anatomy of Hydrocotyle asterias Cham. & Schltdl., a representative of this family. Leaf blade fragments containing marginal teeth were processed using standard light microscopy techniques (diaphanization, paradermal cuts, and histochemical tests) and scanning electron microscopy. The teeth of H. asterias consist of hydathodes, whose size, shape, and interdental spacing vary across different stages of leaf development. They exhibit a unistratified epidermis composed of isodiametric cells with slightly thickened walls, a thin cuticle, and stomata concentrated in the apical region. The vascularization consists of xylem projecting into the epithem. This study provides the first information on the anatomical structure of leaf teeth in the Araliaceae family and expands knowledge about hydathodes located on leaf teeth.

This study highlights the trajectories of 19 Brazilian entrepreneurs operating startups established in Canada. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews with the respondents. Given the scarcity of studies concerning Brazilian entrepreneurs in Canada, we sought to identify their main barriers, difficulties, opportunities, and successful strategies implemented in the country. The article opens with a discussion on immigrant entrepreneurship and startup creation. Next, it addresses the migratory movement of Brazilians to Canada, discussing Brazilian businesses in general and startups, focusing on the definition of startups and their profile in Brazil, as well as the Canadian startup ecosystem. As a theoretical contribution, this article confronts the collected data with immigrant entrepreneurship theories, startup effectuation theory, and the Uppsala model to theoretically outline the elements observed in the surveyed group. At the end of the article, a diagram illustrating the immigrant entrepreneur's journey in designing and validating their business model is presented; the conclusions may contribute to entrepreneurial theories by demonstrating specific aspects of the Canadian startup context. As practical implications, the study can provide data for prospective policies aimed at attracting more qualified and skilled Brazilian entrepreneurs to the Canadian technology ecosystem.

The objective of this study was to estimate the potential for soil loss using the Universal Soil Loss Equation (USLE) and to identify the factors controlling the erosive process in a hillslope watershed. The rainfall erosivity factor (R) was calculated using normal precipitation data, yielding monthly erosion indices.
